messages:
Iris: Noticing a sudden spike in 5xx for embeddings.read in us-east1 around 14:07 UTC. Customers filed errors. Posting status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2823456789 :rotating_light:
Pager-Bot: Incident INC-2823456789 created. Runbook: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/embeds-read-throttle. Pager notified to oncall.
Dev (oncall): Acknowledged. Pulling traces and sampling failed request IDs. Initial sign shows upstream mirror returning RSTs under load.
Kai: Infra: we9re seeing increased egress to partner mirror region-us-mirror; applying short-term per-tenant soft-throttles and spinning up two extra read replicas. Rolling changes now.
Dev (oncall): Applied soft-throttles (policy: softmirror-2026-03) and +2 replicas. Early metric: 5xx rate down from ~13% -> ~4.5% in 6m.
Maya: SRE: enabling a bypass for small reads and reducing retry exponent to limit amplification. Also marking noisy node us-east1-read-09 for drain if we keep seeing kv-timeouts.
CS-Bot: Drafted customer note: "We9re investigating elevated embed read errors in us-east1 impacting higher-throughput tenants. Mitigations in flight; updates at https://status.redwood.ai." Approve to publish?
Iris: Approve. Add workaround: reduce batch sizes for high-throughput customers until recovery.
Dev (oncall): Logs and CI: https://logs.redwood.ai/2823456789  https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/83321. Next steps: monitor for 30m, cordon us-east1-read-09 if KV timeouts persist, and open partner support ticket re: mirror throttling.
Kai: Noted correlated rate-limit spike from partner mirror; opening partner ops channel and requesting their throttling logs.
Iris: Preliminary status: mitigation reduced impact; majority of customers recovering. Will leave thread open until stable for 1hr and then publish an interim summary + RCA placeholder. Exec one-liner: "Transient embeddings.read errors in us-east1 due to downstream mirror throttling; soft-throttles and autoscale restored most traffic; RCA pending." :white_check_mark:
Dev (oncall): Tagging failed request IDs with INC-2823456789 for postmortem. If error rate >3% for next 15m, re-open pager. Thanks team.
